generation_common.initial: uniform at the run's volume fraction

admission.hard_checks: all measure_case hard checks pass under the comparison profile
admission.output_sign: q_source > 0 and q_free > 0 along the contract output direction

rules.enlarged_selection: work-package-2 maximin (k=6, min_distance=0.05, floor=0.1) on pool v1 plus the new admitted, geometry-valid designs
rules.geometry_valid: clean binary load path connected, at least 2 support nodes, floor-free hard checks pass (work package 1)
rules.not_claimed: no convergence, no optimality; q_source never ranked across conditions or springs
rules.novelty: xor on the common fine grid to the nearest geometry-valid pool-v1 design; novel if >= 0.2
